about: Known fuzz findings (plan W1.27) that are not fixed yet. Each one expires (at most 90 days out): after that date the finding fails the run again. Crashes are never listed here.

findings.what: 8–14 KB inputs with deep nesting (lists, block quotes, [[ runs, footnotes, directives) take 0.5–2.8 s in the remark/rehype chain, measured alone in the Vercel Sandbox (Node 24).
findings.next: Render the preview in a worker with a deadline, or bound nesting depth before parsing; then delete this entry.
